title: Read/Write Compaction
summary: Scan every input item with a read pointer while a write pointer marks the end of the compacted valid prefix.
recognition_signals: relative order of kept items should be preserved
one pointer reads candidates while another marks output position
core_rules: Before each read step, positions before the write pointer contain exactly the kept processed items in final relative order.
Advance the write pointer only when an item is kept.
structural_steps: decide whether the current item belongs in the result
write kept items at the write position
advance write only after keeping an item

common_confusions.distinction: Read/write pointers move in the same direction with different roles; opposing pointers start at different boundaries and move toward each other.
